 New Netflix series starring Song Hye-kyo, Gong Yoo to premiere in December
 A scene from "Tantara" / Courtesy of Netflix
 By Yonhap Published Oct 22, 2026 10:37 AM KST 
 "Tantara," a new Netflix original Korean series starring actors Song Hye-kyo and Gong Yoo, will be released on Dec. 11, the streaming platform said Thursday.
 Set in the 1960s-80s, the period drama follows Min-ja (Song), who overcomes poverty and ventures into the recording industry, and her childhood friend Dong-gu (Gong), who supports her dream.
 The show's cast also includes Kim Seol-hyun, Cha Seung-won, Lee Hanee and Na Moon-hee.
 The upcoming series marks star screenwriter Noh Hee-kyung's return after more than four years. Noh has penned popular works such as "Worlds Within" (2008) and "That Winter, the Wind Blows" (2013) — both starring Song — as well as "Our Blues" (2022).
